subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Groups common words into sound families

show.line: Cat, hat, mat, bat. They all end with at. They are a word family! Say them with me.

rounds.prompt: Which picture is in the at family? It ends like cat.
Which picture is in the og family? It ends like dog.
Pin, bin, fin. Say one more word that ends like pin.
Which word does not belong with cat and hat?
rounds.praise: Yes! Bus does not end with at.

rounds.prompt: At family or og family? Put each picture in its group.
Read the word on the card. Which picture matches?
rounds.praise: Mat! It ends with at, like cat.

hints: Listen to the end of the word. Cat, hat. Same ending!
Say both words slowly. Do they end the same way?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word in the at family.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Cat, hat, dog! Dog is in the at family.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Dog ends with og. Rat is in the at family.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Cat, hat, rat. They all end with at!

parent_line: Can group words into families by their ending sound.
